_meta.name: painterly_portrait
_meta.purpose: Daydream toon portrait. SDXL base + watercolor LoRA at 22 steps, portrait aspect.
operator_notes: Same checkpoint + LoRA as painterly_room.json; only the canvas and negatives differ.
640x768 portrait aspect for the scene-margin chips and picker thumbnails.
Negative prompt adds face/anatomy terms (faces are the hard subject under the loose watercolor LoRA).
A/B a framing: bin/game image-test '<appearance seed>, <framing clause>' --workflow painterly_portrait.json
The framing decision (figure vignette over head-and-shoulders) is recorded in WHIMSY.md 'Portrait prompt suffix'.

inputs.text: harsh edges, pixel art, 8-bit, neon, photorealistic, modern technology, machinery, vehicle, computer, text, watermark, signature, deformed, low quality, deformed face, distorted face, asymmetric eyes, cross-eyed, extra limbs, extra fingers, mutated hands, disfigured
